key_insight: Generative design and consensus GNN screening identified four novel bimetallic HER candidates with DFT-validated near-thermoneutral hydrogen binding: Pd5Au, Pt5Rh, Cu5Pt3, and Pd13Ru3.
engineering_relevance: The pipeline narrows computational searches to promising alloy compositions and surfaces for experimental hydrogen-evolution catalyst development.
method: Fine-tune MatterGen on adsorption-labelled bulk alloys to generate novel binaries targeting near-zero hydrogen adsorption energy.
Use MatterSim to screen surface stability and relax hydrogen-adsorbed slabs at high-symmetry sites.
Combine MEGNet–ALIGNN consensus with MatterSim energy checks, then validate shortlisted alloys using DFT and phonons.
evidence_signal: Of eight shortlisted alloys evaluated with plane-wave DFT, four met the thermoneutral hydrogen-binding criterion, and all eight were dynamically stable in phonon calculations.
watch_item: Experimental HER activity and durability remain unverified, and the four highlighted candidates contain precious metals despite the earth-abundance motivation.
paper_title: Generative Design and Graph Neural Network Screening of Novel Bimetallic Alloy Catalysts for the Hydrogen Evolution Reaction
